title: Unchanging SMP
description: This is the modpack for The Unchanging SMP, a private smp for a group of friends
body:
This is a modpack made for a group of friends for our server called the Unchanging SMP.                                                                                      
Overworld Changes: | New tree variants! |![My Skin Pointing at the description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc0b5ce716721fab6a276c451c03c3fcf16d67aa.png) 
                   | New structures to explore! |

QOL Features: / Backpacks for more inventory space!
              / Sleeping bags for sleeping without resetting our spawn point!
              / Enchantment Descriptions!
              / Jumping over fences!
              / Dynamic Lights!
              / Mini maps and World maps!
              / Mouse Improvements!
              / Right clicking to harvest!
              / New storage solutions!
              / Waystones for easy teleportation!/
